name: unblob
summary: Extract files from any kind of container formats.
highlights: -e — Extract the files to this directory. Will be created if doesn't exist.
-f — Force extraction even if outputs already exist (they are removed).
-P — Load plugins from the provided path.
-S — Skip processing files with given magic prefix. The provided values are appended to unblob'
--skip-extension — Skip processing files with given extension [default: .rlib]
--clear-skip-magics — Clear unblob's own skip magic list.
--report — File to store metadata generated during the extraction process (in JSON format).
--log — File to save logs (in text format). Defaults to unblob.log.

flags.name: --extract-dir
flags.description: Extract the files to this directory. Will be created if doesn't exist.

flags.name: --force
flags.description: Force extraction even if outputs already exist (they are removed).

flags.name: --plugins-path
flags.description: Load plugins from the provided path.

flags.name: --skip-magic
flags.description: Skip processing files with given magic prefix. The provided values are appended to unblob's own skip magic list unless --clear- skip-magic is provided. [default: BFLT, Erlang BEAM file, GIF, GNU message catalog, HP Printer Job Language, JPEG, Java module image, MPEG, MS Windows icon resource, Macromedia Flash data, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Word, OpenDocument, PDF document, PNG, SQLite, TrueType Font data, Web Open Font Format, Windows Embedded CE binary image, Xilinx BIT data, compiled Java class, magic binary file, python]
flags.default: BFLT, Erlang BEAM file, GIF, GNU message catalog, HP Printer Job Language, JPEG, Java module image, MPEG, MS Windows icon resource, Macromedia Flash data, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint, Microsoft Word, OpenDocument, PDF document, PNG, SQLite, TrueType Font data, Web Open Font Format, Windows Embedded CE binary image, Xilinx BIT data, compiled Java class, magic binary file, python

flags.name: --skip-extension
flags.description: Skip processing files with given extension [default: .rlib]

flags.name: --clear-skip-magics
flags.description: Clear unblob's own skip magic list.

flags.name: --report
flags.description: File to store metadata generated during the extraction process (in JSON format).

flags.name: --log
flags.description: File to save logs (in text format). Defaults to unblob.log.

flags.name: --skip-extraction
flags.description: Only carve chunks and skip further extraction

flags.name: --no-sandbox
flags.description: Disable Landlock sandboxing (useful for breakpoint-based debugging).

flags.name: --delete-extracted-files
flags.description: Delete fully extracted intermediate files (whole-file chunks only). Use 'selected:<handler1,handler2>' (comma- separated) to restrict deletions to specific handlers. [default: none]

flags.name: --carve-suffix
flags.description: Carve directory name is source file + this suffix. NOTE: carving is skipped when the whole file is of a known type [default: _extract]

flags.name: --extract-suffix
flags.description: Extraction directory name is source file + this suffix [default: _extract]

flags.name: --show-external-dependencies
flags.description: Shows commands needs to be available for unblob to work properly
